integrity: The result follows from an exact derivative factorization after positive-affine normalization to support (0,t,1). The factor is affine in t, so the entire phase diagram, stationary point, boundary values, and attainment behavior are algebraically determined. Exact-rational replay verifies the identities but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies exactly three ordered atoms with fixed positive probabilities; four or more atoms are not covered.
The two Bernoulli boundary values are sharp limits and are not attained by a genuine three-point law.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent result in older moment-space or weighted-data literature.
title: Complete kurtosis phase diagram for three-point laws with fixed masses
